entries.reason: Launches $EDITOR/$VISUAL on the config file; the user interacts with it directly. Reached only when isInteractive() is true (#3062) and --print-path was not given; headless callers use --print-path or `aiwg config set` instead.

Hands the terminal to the codex binary the user is meant to talk to. Reached only when extraArgs is not already a non-interactive form (e.g. `exec <prompt>`) and isInteractive() is true (#3062); the non-interactive/no-terminal paths use the bounded helper or refuse instead.

Runs the codex OAuth login flow, which prompts the user directly. Reached only when no apiKeyEnv was given and isInteractive() is true (#3062); headless callers pass apiKeyEnv (codex login --with-api-key) instead.

Hands the terminal to the configured provider binary (claude/codex/...) the user is meant to talk to. Reached only when no --prompt/--prompt-file was supplied and isInteractive() is true (#3062); headless callers pass --prompt/--prompt-file instead.

Runs an arbitrary manifest-author-defined shell command with inherited stdio; it may itself prompt. Reached only when isInteractive() is true (#3062); the no-terminal path uses the bounded helper instead.

Runs an arbitrary manifest-author-defined script file with inherited stdio; it may itself prompt. Reached only when isInteractive() is true (#3062); the no-terminal path uses the bounded helper instead.

Opens $EDITOR on a conflicted file from the interactive conflict-resolution menu; the user interacts with it directly. handleConflicts() returns before reaching this call whenever !process.stdin.isTTY (#3062), so it is reached only when attached to a terminal.
